statement_IPOTESI: In WWOX-deficient neural cells with raised GSK3 activity, GSK3 inhibition lowers phospho-Ser535 (human Ser540) of eIF2B epsilon and raises exchange activity and new-protein labelling beyond what the same compound does in the isogenic corrected cells
compound_or_tool: an ATP-site GSK3 inhibitor of a defined chemotype, and a second inhibitor of a different class (named in IT15 target-first: LY-2090314, laduviglusib, TDZD-8; SB-216763 and SB-415286 as used in 12133000); lithium only as a labelled non-specific comparator
documented_action_on_the_node: GSK3 inhibition and dephosphorylation of Ser535 documented for LiCl, SB-415286 and SB-216763 in CHO cells (abstract level) and for genetic Gsk3b loss in mouse neurons; per-compound GSK3 isoform ratios are in the IT15 package For LY-2090314, laduviglusib and TDZD-8, Ser535 dephosphorylation is not documented in any source seen; the documented action is for LiCl, SB-415286 and SB-216763 only (audit).
tool_or_candidate: experimental tools; no repurposing candidate is named or promoted (the IT15 abstention stands)
context: WWOX-deficient human neurons or oligodendrocyte-lineage cells, stage matched, with the baseline pS535 and p-eIF2 alpha measured first
benefit_if_true: a correction of translation and one functional read-out specific to the null (not seen in controls)
refuted_or_replaced_by: (a) pS535 not raised at baseline: the chain breaks at L1 or L2; (b) pS535 falls but exchange and translation do not move (the CHO result, E06): site not sufficient; (c) effect also in corrected cells or unchanged by S535A: off-target (E07); (d) effect disappears when phospho-eIF2 alpha is lowered: the ISR route
requires_first: repeat of the single-lane Ser9 blot with replicate lanes and total GSK3 (E01 limits)

statement_IPOTESI: The relevant GSK3 isoform in WWOX-deficient neurons is beta, as in retinal ganglion cells, so a beta-directed knock-down reproduces the compound effect and an alpha-directed one does not
compound_or_tool: GSK3B and GSK3A knock-down (genetic tools) alongside the two compounds
documented_action_on_the_node: Gsk3b deletion lowers phospho-Ser535, Gsk3a deletion does not (E13, E14)
benefit_if_true: an isoform-resolved reading that prevents attributing a compound effect to the wrong isoform
refuted_or_replaced_by: alpha also acts, or neither isoform changes pS535 in this cell type (the retinal result does not transfer)

statement_IPOTESI: Replacing eIF2B epsilon by the Ser-to-Ala form (species numbering checked: human 540, mouse 536, rat 535) restores translation in WWOX-deficient cells to the corrected level, and the catalytically dead epsilon (E572A, as used in 26974342) removes it
compound_or_tool: eIF2B epsilon phospho-resistant and phospho-mimetic forms, plus the catalytically dead form
documented_action_on_the_node: S535A raised protein synthesis in mouse neurons and E572A removed the Gsk3b-deletion gain (E15, E16)
benefit_if_true: shows the node, not the kinase, carries the defect; separates GSK3 from other kinases acting on the same site (DYRK2 is annotated at the priming serine)
refuted_or_replaced_by: no change with S535A: the translation defect, if any, lies elsewhere; or the Ala form alone raises translation in controls (an effect of the mutation, not a rescue)
requires_first: H1 baseline S535A cannot separate GSK3 from DYRK2, which acts at the priming Ser539, a different residue (audit).

statement_IPOTESI: ISRIB (an eIF2B activator) is a discriminating probe, not an assumed rescue: if the defect is a GSK3-site lesion independent of phospho-eIF2, ISRIB is predicted to give little correction; if a stability or conformational component is present, it may give some [IT38] ISRIB giving little is also the expected result when phospho-eIF2 alpha is not raised, and without an engagement control and effective exposure it is uninformative; it does not by itself separate the GSK3 serine from other explanations (IT37 audit).
compound_or_tool: ISRIB, with the phospho-mimetic epsilon as a positive test of the idea
documented_action_on_the_node: ISRIB acts mostly by antagonising phosphorylated eIF2 and only weakly without it (E20 to E22), and rescues stability-lowering mutants (E25); no source tests it on a phospho-epsilon lesion (E23)
tool_or_candidate: experimental tool; potency facts only, no dose proposed
context: as H1, with the S535 phospho-mimetic epsilon and the wild-type in parallel
benefit_if_true: separates a GSK3-site mechanism from the generic ISR mechanism, which is the question asked
refuted_or_replaced_by: ISRIB corrects equally with and without phospho-eIF2 alpha: then it acts by a route not described in the sources read
requires_first: H3 constructs A phosphomimetic at 535 is unvalidated (audit).

statement_IPOTESI: The GSK3 route is not engaged in WWOX-deficient neurons and ISR changes, if any, come from another input
benefit_if_true: the ISR need keeps its own premise (protein-level ISR sign) and the GSK3 need keeps the Wnt and Tau questions
refuted_or_replaced_by: This is the null of H1 and H3, to be stated before the measurement
